name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Removed the floating download-progress toast that appeared at the bottom of the screen on every page - it read as this plugin editing jellyfin-web's own chrome, which wasn't the goal. Download progress is still visible everywhere it matters: the pill next to the title and the progress ring drawn on the cover art (both on the item's own page), and the Downloads section on the Federation settings page.

198 tests (unchanged).
